title: One Seamless Workflow With Clo-Set: Asset Management (Company Library)
description:
CLO-SET is a cloud-based platform that enables users to collaborate easily with the entire clothing-making process through 3D file management, sharing, and real-time communication.

Organize your 3D assets in the Company Library and access them directly in CLO, right when you need them.

- Visit CLO-SET https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus
- Join Discord: https://discord.com/invite/G2eaK3PDSu 
- For any questions, visit https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us
transcript: In this lesson, we will learn how to manage and utilize 3D assets in Closet. First, we will go to the company library and create a workroom to organize assets. We will create workrooms to organize and store different types of 3D assets such as fabrics, blocks, trims, and avatars. Once the workrooms are ready, we will upload assets to each workroom. Click new in the top left corner and select upload file to upload 3D assets from your device. After uploading, preview 3D assets in the workroom and easily search for them by file name. Adding category information makes it easier to search for assets. Select a file then click the floating menu at the top to assign a category. Once categories are set, you can quickly find assets using the category filter. Now let's open the asset in Closet and use it to develop your garment. In Closet, click the library button on the right top to access the company library from Closet. Open a garment file and apply fabric assets from the object browser. Drag and drop trim assets such as buttons into the object browser to further develop the garment. By applying materials and trims, you can develop and refine the garment during the sampling stage. We'll explain more about the template and theТы can use to create your own templates, and how to use Closet. First, you'll need a template to create your own template. Add a template and copy and paste a template using the template folder.
markdown_content: ## Overview: Managing 3D Assets in Clo-Set (Company Library) This section covers the end-to-end workflow for organizing and using 3D assets in **Clo-Set**, starting in the **Company Library** and ending with applying assets to a garment during sampling. It focuses on creating **workrooms**, uploading and previewing assets, and then using those assets inside Clo-Set to develop garments. ## Create Workrooms in the Company Library This section explains how to set up **workrooms** in the **company library** to organize different types of 3D assets. Workrooms act as containers where you upload, preview, and manage assets by asset type. 1. Open the **Company Library**. 2. Create a **workroom** to organize assets. 3. Create additional workrooms as needed for different asset types, including: - **Fabrics** - **Blocks** - **Trims** - **Avatars** Once the workrooms are created, you can upload assets into the appropriate workroom for easier management and retrieval later. ## Upload, Preview, and Search Assets by File Name This section covers uploading 3D assets to a specific workroom and using the workroom’s search capabilities. It includes the key UI actions for uploading files and verifying them via preview. 1. In the workroom, click **New** (top-left corner). 2. Select **Upload file** to upload 3D assets from your device. 3. After uploading, **preview** the 3D assets inside the workroom. 4. Search for assets using the **file name**. ## Add Categories to Improve Asset Search This section describes how **category metadata** improves discovery of assets. After categories are assigned, you can use a **category filter** to quickly find the right assets. 1. Select a file in the workroom. 2. Click the **floating menu** at the top. 3. Assign a **category** to the asset. 4. Use the **category filter** to quickly locate assets once categories are set. ## Use Assets in Clo-Set to Develop a Garment This section explains how to access the **Company Library from inside Clo-Set** and apply assets to garment development. It covers importing **fabric assets** and adding **trim assets** (e.g., buttons) via drag-and-drop. 1. In Clo-Set, click the **library** button (top-right) to access the **company library** from within Clo-Set. 2. Open a **garment file**. 3. Apply **fabric assets** using the **object browser**. 4. Drag and drop **trim assets** (such as **buttons**) into the **object browser** to further develop the garment. Applying **materials** and **trims** supports garment refinement during the **sampling stage**. ## Templates: Required Setup for Creating Custom Templates This section outlines the requirement to have a template before creating your own, and how to add/copy templates using the template folder. It also sets up the workflow for using Clo-Set templates. - You need a **template** in order to create your own template. - Add a template and **copy and paste** a template using the **template folder**.
